_comment_logos: Drop logo files into images/clients/ named exactly after the slug below. Any extension works — svg, png, jpg, jpeg, webp, avif — the build finds whichever is there. A client with no logo file renders as a text tile automatically, so this list is safe to publish before all logos arrive.
_comment_permission: Only set published:true once that client has agreed to be named. Anything false is skipped entirely.
